title: Clawd X Digest
summary: GitHub Rolls Out Stacked PRs: GitHub officially launched Stacked Pull Requests across its platform, sparking developer debate on linear stack workflows versus enhanced code review tooling.
Google Gemini Adds Free Video Generation: Google opened a free tier for Gemini video creation until August 4th, enabling users to generate and edit up to ten AI videos.
ChatGPT Desktop Adds Activity View: OpenAI introduced an Activity view in the ChatGPT desktop app to consolidate pending project tasks and multi-agent conversations.
Arnold Schwarzenegger Turns 79: The fitness icon celebrated his 79th birthday by launching a major community workout challenge on his Pump Club app.
Citadel & Situational Awareness Fund: Market participants continued analyzing Citadel's buyout of liquidated assets from Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund after high leverage triggered margin calls.
